request: Investigate order ORD-1003. Is anything wrong, and what should we do?

steps.text: I will look up the order details to see its status, promised delivery date, warehouse, and items to determine if there's a delay or potential stock issue.
I will retrieve the shipment tracking to confirm if the delivery is overdue and see any carrier-recorded delay reason or stalled tracking.

shipments.recorded_delay_reason: Carrier reported hub closure at Toledo, OH due to winter storm

events.description: Hub closed due to winter storm; revised ETA 2026-03-18

arguments.summary: Yes—delivery is delayed. The carrier reports a hub closure in Toledo, OH due to a winter storm; the shipment is overdue by 7 days with a revised ETA of 2026-03-18.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1003 fulfillment_status SHIPPED, promised_delivery_date 2026-03-09, investigation_date 2026-03-16, is_past_promised_date true.
get_shipment_status: SHP-5003 (Great Lakes Freight, tracking GLF-88231) status DELAYED, current_estimated_delivery_date 2026-03-18, is_overdue true, days_past_promised_date 7.
get_shipment_status: recorded_delay_reason "Carrier reported hub closure at Toledo, OH due to winter storm".
get_shipment_status: events include ARRIVED_AT_HUB at Toledo, OH on 2026-03-06; DELAY at Toledo, OH on 2026-03-07 (hub closed); DEPARTED_HUB Toledo, OH on 2026-03-12; days_since_last_event 4.
get_shipment_status: dispatch_date 2026-03-04 equals ship_by_date 2026-03-04; dispatched_late false.
arguments.likely_cause: Carrier hub closure at Toledo, OH due to a winter storm, as recorded by the carrier.
uncertainties: Whether the shipment will meet the updated ETA of 2026-03-18 since the last tracking event was 2026-03-12 (4 days ago).

recommended_actions.details: Contact Great Lakes Freight for shipment SHP-5003 (tracking GLF-88231) to request a trace, current location, and confirmation of the revised ETA 2026-03-18; the shipment is overdue by 7 days per get_shipment_status and has had no scan since 2026-03-12.

Inform Contoso Hardware that order ORD-1003 is delayed due to a carrier hub closure in Toledo, OH from a winter storm (per get_shipment_status) and provide the current ETA of 2026-03-18; advise that we are confirming with the carrier and will update them if the date changes.

arguments.recommendation: Contact Great Lakes Freight to confirm the 2026-03-18 ETA for SHP-5003, then notify the customer with the cause and updated delivery date.
